methods.comment:
* Searches for the next frame in {@code input}. * *

The peek position is advanced to the start of the found frame, or at the end of the stream * if no frame was found. * * @param input The input from which to search (starting from the peek position). * @return The number of the first sample in the found frame, or the total number of samples in * the stream if no frame was found. * @throws IOException If peeking from the input fails. In this case, there is no guarantee on * the peek position.
